verdict.rationale: Bruno is offline-only with no cloud sync and no account. Collections are saved as plain-text files in a filesystem folder the user picks, and are shared through the user's own Git remote, so data residency is wholly under the user's control. AI features are Bring Your Own Key, with no data routed through Bruno servers, and can point to self-hosted or local models such as Ollama, so AI traffic location is also user-chosen. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation framing this as region/data-residency control, and independent hands-on corroboration of residency guarantees (community comments only imply it).
